title: SIGNALJAMAL breaks the silence with self-dreamers anthem, "NO FRICTION"
htmlContent: "NO FRICTION" is a statement of strength, and the first single from SIGNALJAMAL's debut EP, "SIGNAL," which is scheduled for release in February. It sounds like the spark that comes before the fire. This is the story of an artist who built everything from scratch. No team and no easy ways out. It is a musical representation of staying dedicated while alone, enduring long, hard nights, uncertain of what will happen, and silently praying for the music to be louder than the noise around it, and it finally happens. The lyrics of the song convey a profound honesty that resonates with both individuals and the general public. https://open.spotify.com/track/2DE7xoblUOJXxiTKVBkMG1 SIGNALJAMAL shows the struggle as it is. Even though people told him he probably would fail, he has learnt to rely on faith, believing that purpose and timing have always worked in his favour. It is about truth and existence. "NO FRICTION" combines melodic pop with grounded rap, featuring cinematic layers that add depth and atmosphere. There is a tension between resilience and elegance, between struggle and ease, and this balance was planned. The first song on his SIGNAL EP, "NO FRICTION," shows that he is determined to stay true to himself and not give in to the temptation of attention. SIGNALJAMAL is making his own way, and if this single is any indication, the breakthrough is already happening. Follow SIGNALJAMAL on Facebook and Instagram
